review.scope: Source-only completeness audit of Realm swaps, immutable UserCallable Realm, secondary code consumers and environment identity protection; no builds/tests/measurements run.

secondary_consumers_checked.interpreter.rs:576: Function profiler uses active-genv selection; unguarded selector is cfg(test).
secondary_consumers_checked.interpreter.rs:14385: Forwarding initializer selects compatible code before caching a structurally pure initializer plan.
secondary_consumers_checked.interpreter.rs:15112: Checked native call fill chooses compatible code.
secondary_consumers_checked.interpreter.rs:15366: Ordinary/derived compiled call chooses compatible code after callee-Realm entry.
secondary_consumers_checked.interpreter.rs:15660: Prepared body dispatch chooses compatible code after its existing FDI.
secondary_consumers_checked.interpreter.rs:15855: Async continuation lookup uses compatible selection; native optimizer admission remains unsupported for coroutine entries.
secondary_consumers_checked.jit_optimizing.rs:356: Hot publication validates the currently selected immutable baseline against ctx.genv.
secondary_consumers_checked.bytecode.rs:15222: Active AST-to-VM OSR deliberately uses primary canonical frame layout rather than a newly selected secondary body.
secondary_consumers_checked.interpreter.rs:15774: Generator continuation uses its primary body; suspended entries are not admitted to secondary/native optimization.
secondary_consumers_checked.memory.rs:854: Memory visitor inventories both secondary slots independently; it does not dispatch execution.

identity_checks.user_creation: Sole Callable::user construction records Rc::as_ptr(self.global); UserCallable clone preserves realm. Prototype/environment changes cannot change it. Bound/proxy/native resolution remains separate.
identity_checks.inline_guards: Bytecode, ARM64, x64 and optimizing guards require planning global-env identity; every real InlineTarget retains a Weak Scope allocation-header pin and optimizer clones retain it. Guards therefore need no epoch for that identity.
identity_checks.raw_call_caches: All real call/construct fills pin active global_env. Rust callbacks, construct caches, overflow probes and ARM64 shared probes validate global-env plus current non-sentinel epoch before leasing code. GC increments that epoch before releasing expired interpreter global-env Weak pins. Prepared entries can only be created through a nonsentinel guarded resolver and revalidate before use.
identity_checks.active_code: Current frames and raw cache users acquire code leases before compilation/GC/reclamation; Realm-aware selection governs new entries and does not rewrite active canonical slots/PCs.
identity_checks.x64_fallback: x64 Op::Call/New checked helpers reach the same Rust selector/cache validation. Its native InlineGuard checks JitCtx.genv at the asserted64-byte offset and retains planning allocation identity through owning Chunk metadata.

nested_realm_and_error_review.ownership: Entry snapshots the target while its registry root stays present. Swap transfers caller owners to saved stack state. Normal or JS abrupt completion swaps back and publishes updated target. No observer holds a mutable registry borrow.
nested_realm_and_error_review.host_context: call_user captures target/caller context tokens before their roles swap; restoration uses original caller token.
nested_realm_and_error_review.constructor_errors: construct_inner creates ctor_caller_realm from saved caller after entry swap and restores outer ctor_caller_realm before exit swap. throw_in_caller_realm temporarily installs that caller for post-callee derived-return validation errors.
existing_test_evidence_reviewed: jit_inline_realm_selection_tests.rs prepared/shared-identity and Weak lease fixtures
nested_realm_and_error_review.limits: Source preserves existing Rust panic/unwind restoration policy; it is not a new panic-safe Realm guard.

remaining_performance_coverage.finding: Cross-Realm suspended continuation entry/exit still uses snapshot+restore cloning. This is an unchanged performance path, with no demonstrated semantic mismatch.
Caller-Realm error creation still uses snapshot+restore cloning. It intentionally supplies caller error intrinsics after callee completion; no mismatch found.

The uncached pure initializer-plan path still walks up to8 environment parents instead of checking immutable user.realm. It can conservatively decline deep or host-environment-replaced same-Realm initializers. Checked fallback remains correct; measured importance not established.
Realm creation continues to snapshot the creator while fresh target intrinsics are built. This cold construction path is outside converted call boundaries.

test_coverage_limits.finding: No native x86-64 execution was performed on this aarch64-only toolchain. The reviewed x64 guard/helper source is consistent, but source review and portable Rust typechecking do not establish emitted-machine-code execution correctness.

The new expired-global-env fixture proves actual stale native CallIc rejection plus a live-pin control. ConstructIc/ConstructSite and overflow use the same epoch contract and are audited, but no separate actual constructor identity-reuse regression was added. A retained old-context constructor invoked/cached in a later context would provide that focused extension.

Existing nested callback/GC intrinsic tests cover all three tiers; the derived return-error Realm fixture explicitly covers one foreign constructor on the default tier. A nested third-Realm constructor with callback/GC followed by invalid return would strengthen combined outer ctor_caller_realm restoration coverage, without implying a current defect.

report.purpose: Current-machine baseline Phase0 followed by three interleaved default-candidate screen pairs with outer aggregate load capture

measurement_policy.phase0: Baseline-only runs finish before any candidate timing; report median/MAD/range without inference from three samples.
measurement_policy.regression_threshold: Three-round screen is descriptive only. Stable current Phase0 permits the fixed 3% median loss concern threshold. Final acceptance requires at least seven matched pairs and all functional/conformance evidence; noisy Phase0 or external load limits precision, not correctness.
measurement_policy.artifact_placement: Independent fresh tmpfs copies for each process; hashes verified before launch.
measurement_policy.timing_instrumentation: Unmodified official one-shot completion collector only; no trace, metrics, functional-state observer or post-completion timer.
measurement_policy.outer_load_capture: CPU4 controller thread samples aggregate /proc CPU/load/pressure plus exact-owned-browser CPU/affinity once per second; no in-page polling or foreign command lines.

limitations: Selected subset composite is not an official full-suite Speedometer score.
Headless measures JS/DOM/layout/event-loop work and renderer-neutral paint preparation, not continuous desktop presentation.
One iteration per fresh browser is a cold-to-warm application pass, not steady state.
Timing cannot observe every buffered JS error; separate functional companions validate errors/output.
Kernel VmHWM is per browser process and observed through /proc; sampled process-group RSS is separate.
No optimizing application execution is inferred from selecting hot; separate diagnostic coverage is required.

measurement_policy.regression_threshold: Three-round screen is descriptive only. Stable current Phase0 permits the fixed 3% median loss concern threshold. Final acceptance requires at least seven matched pairs and all functional/conformance evidence; noisy Phase0 or external load limits precision, not correctness.
measurement_policy.artifact_placement: Independent fresh tmpfs copies for each process; hashes verified before launch.
measurement_policy.timing_instrumentation: Unmodified official one-shot completion collector only; no trace, metrics, functional-state observer or post-completion timer.
measurement_policy.outer_load_capture: CPU4 controller thread samples aggregate /proc CPU/load/pressure plus exact-owned-browser CPU/affinity once per second; no in-page polling or foreign command lines.

limitations: Selected subset composite is not an official full-suite Speedometer score.
Headless measures JS/DOM/layout/event-loop work and renderer-neutral paint preparation, not continuous desktop presentation.
One iteration per fresh browser is a cold-to-warm application pass, not steady state.
Timing cannot observe every buffered JS error; separate functional companions validate errors/output.
Kernel VmHWM is per browser process and observed through /proc; sampled process-group RSS is separate.
No optimizing application execution is inferred from selecting hot; separate diagnostic coverage is required.

exit.error_visibility: completion only; separate functional companion required

resources.cpu_observation: Last sampled process CPU, not complete wait4 accounting; lower bound at2s sample interval.

limitations: Aggregate machine/CPU5 activity only; no foreign command lines or private browser data read.
Kernel counters are asynchronous and rounded; process sampling misses final CPU before exit.
Busy minus sampled browser CPU is approximate and may be negative; retain raw values without clipping.
Residual is emitted only when all observed browser thread affinity masks are exactly CPU5.
This outer monitor changes no JavaScript collector or official benchmark steps.

quiet_window_interruption.attribution: Unattributed observed executable; no confirmed team build or source provenance inferred. User unrelated processes left untouched. Entire cohort retained as diagnostics, excluded from acceptance.

selected_browser_screen.additional_limit: Median launch-minus-official residual is 20.03% higher in this N3 screen (.627/.670/.626 s baseline versus .627/.822/.751 s candidate). Exact driver/collector source review shows the residual combines launch-to-collector prefix with report-construction/transport/validation suffix. Existing records cannot partition it or isolate startup.

clock_label_correction.correct_interpretation: driver wall_s minus collector measurementWallMs/1000: prefix plus suffix

driver_clock.scope: Immediately before spawning taskset/browser through completion parsing and validation.

collector_clock.scope: After module imports and eight RAF callbacks, before client.start, through constructing the final report field before summary lookup and delivery serialization.

record.residual: driver wall_s minus collector measurementWallMs/1000 combines an initialization/preflight prefix and report construction/transport/validation suffix. It is not a standalone startup or preflight measurement.
record.unresolved: Existing records cannot partition the residual or establish the cause of its variation.

comparison.scope: Four selected TodoMVC suites/12 actions; every100 English label, item/completed/checked count and deletion state. V2 fresh companion is excluded from timing and overlaps release conformance CPUs0–3.

candidate_exit.error_visibility: trace plus normal final JS outcome

browser_functional.limit: Functional companion is timing-ineligible; candidate is fresh v2, baseline artifact and fixture unchanged from the retained baseline companion.

root_audit.reviewer: root; independently parsed raw reports and differential completion lines
limits: Inconclusive bounded seeds are not passes.
Binary and frozen source hashes were separately checked by root before this report; no compiler or tests were rerun during the browser quiet window.
Selected Test262 scopes; not full Test262.
Differential inconclusive cases are not conformance passes.

browser_confirmation_status.supplement_policy: All three interrupted supplementary cohorts are retained but entirely timing-ineligible; no selective pair joining.
browser_confirmation_status.external_activity: After the interrupted runs, a metadata-only root process monitor observed recurring Cargo activity in another project. This does not identify previously exited guard PIDs. No process was signalled.

quiet_window_interruption.attribution: Unattributed observed executable in user-reserved window; no ownership/build inferred. Entire supplement excluded from acceptance under unchanged rule. All nine raw completed processes retained; original valid N3 unchanged.

portable_followup.source_relationship: Main differs from the499-file v2 source snapshot only by the verified portable helper change in value.rs. Other production/compiler work remains exactly frozen v2.
portable_followup.checks: Clean-base fix passes default engine/embed+wasm bindings and no-default-features embed wasm checks; fixed-v2 composition also passes. No Wasm runtime execution claim.
